themes.title: G42 exports UAE AI to Europe via Greece AI factory
themes.summary: Abu Dhabi's G42 is deepening its European footprint, signing Greece AI deals across healthcare, education and cities while exploring an AI factory with the Copelouzos Group. It is a concrete early case of Gulf AI infrastructure internationalising into the EU, where data-residency and sovereignty rules reward local compute.
themes.angle: UAE AI infrastructure is internationalising into the EU; watch data-residency and tech-transfer terms.

themes.title: Gulf AI: sovereignty push meets capital-market reality

UAE-US talks on AI, quantum and space continue alongside Saudi logistics AI adoption.

themes.title: Claude 5.5 family cuts cost of agentic work
themes.summary: Anthropic shipped the Claude 5.5 family: Opus 5.5 leads agentic coding at 40% lower run cost, Sonnet 5.5 is 30%+ faster and up to 30% cheaper, and Haiku 5.5 targets high-volume agent and browser work. The Information frames Anthropic's margin as OpenAI's opportunity as inference-unit economics sharpen.
themes.angle: 30-40% cheaper frontier inference changes the economics of every automation roadmap.

themes.title: AI mega-deals redraw capital flows
themes.summary: Capital is consolidating on AI: OpenAI is reportedly raising ~$30B at a $1.25T valuation (per The Neuron), Musk's proposed Tesla-SpaceX merger goes all in on AI (FT), and a16z renamed its crypto division Frontier while broadening its $2.2B fund to AI and robotics. Tenstorrent's $1.5B round and a Saudi-backed EA buyout complete the deal flow.
themes.angle: From a $1.25T OpenAI valuation to a crypto fund pivoting to AI, capital is consolidating on AI.

themes.title: AI adoption: the payoff question
themes.summary: New data complicates the AI-payoff narrative: Bain finds most software buyers now use AI to find vendors, while Apollo sees no AI payoff outside tech so far. Microsoft AI scored 83% where doctors got 36% on a medical benchmark, and the UK launched an AI lab to monitor biosecurity threats.
themes.angle: Contrarian data: adoption is real, monetisation outside tech is not yet.
